headline_marked: FIFA World Cup 2026: [[World Cup winners to receive championship rings]] for first time
headline: FIFA World Cup 2026: World Cup winners to receive championship rings for first time
summary: FIFA is introducing bespoke rings as a new symbol of achievement for the champions of the expanded 48-team tournament.
details: For the first time in the history of the FIFA World Cup, the winners of the 2026 final will receive championship rings in addition to the iconic trophy and gold medals.
The rings will be presented after the final match between Spain and Argentina at the New York-New Jersey Stadium.
This move adopts a tradition common in American sports, introducing the rings as a symbol of achievement for the expanded 48-team tournament.
A total of 2,026 individually numbered rings have been produced. Thirty of these are reserved for the members of the winning team.
The remaining 1,996 rings will be available worldwide as officially licensed products for fans to purchase.
Each ring features the World Cup trophy on one side and the identity of the winning nation on the other, accompanied by a certificate of authenticity.
The winning captain and head coach will receive temporary rings during the immediate celebrations, with custom-fitted rings presented to the winners at a later date.

headline: Bangladesh face Zimbabwe today to keep T20I series alive
summary: After losing the first match and previous series in the tour, the Tigers must win today's clash in Bulawayo to avoid a series defeat.
details: Bangladesh will face Zimbabwe in the second T20I of their three-match series today, Friday, July 17, at the Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo.
The Tigers are under pressure to win this match as they lost the first T20I by 32 runs, making a victory essential to stay in the series.
The tour has been challenging for Bangladesh, starting with a heavy defeat in the only Test match by an innings and 85 runs.
